title: console: a single-record script action placed in `list_toolbar` silently does nothing when 0 or 2+ rows are selected (no request, no "select exactly one row" refusal), and with 1 row it gives no result feedback
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect, reproduced in a browser.
`reach:` the console list toolbar, measured on the HotCRM Leads list.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01BCDqr1DqnQjEh5jA9gGkUG`) from objectstack-ai/hotcrm's v18 test pass (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 11). ⛔ Not a claim. File-at-destination, for triage.
Reader: the objectui triage seat.
Dedupe: semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, "list toolbar single record script action with zero or multiple rows selected does nothing silently, no refusal message select exactly one row" → 3 hits, all closed and different. Nearest: #2210 (a toolbar launch with zero rows CRASHED a record-scoped run).

## What happens (`@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.0, the console pinned at objectui `1fb1ced`)

As `sales.manager` on Leads: tick 2 rows, click the **header** "Add to Campaign" (top right, not the selection bar's button of the same name), pick "Cloud Migration Webinar", and click Confirm.
- **With 2 rows, or with 0 rows:** the dialog closes and nothing happens. There is no `POST /api/v1/actions/crm_lead/create_campaign`, no toast and no error, and no member is created (read back).
- **With exactly 1 row:** it dispatches (200, `count 0 / skipped 1` for an existing member) but shows no feedback at all.
- The app's action declares itself single-record and expects a client-side refusal, "This action runs on a single record — select exactly one row." (objectstack-ai/hotcrm `src/sales/actions/lead.actions.ts` ~233–240, `list_toolbar` placement.)

Screenshots: [11a, before Confirm](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f99218e05b422543e90a6c39214cc9be3095d3d8/qa/2026-10-13-v18-pass/11a-toolbar-add-to-campaign-two-rows-before-confirm.png) · [11b, after Confirm, nothing happens](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f99218e05b422543e90a6c39214cc9be3095d3d8/qa/2026-10-13-v18-pass/11b-toolbar-add-to-campaign-after-confirm-nothing-happens.png).

## Ask

- A single-record action launched from `list_toolbar` with ≠ 1 row selected is refused visibly, never dropped.
- A dispatched script action's result (`count` / `skipped`) reaches the user.
- HotCRM's half (the single-record button sits beside the bulk bar's same-named button) is the app's to tidy once the console refuses properly.
